contract.intended_consumer: Brian and coding agents starting consequential Agentic Engineering work
contract.outcome: A selected repository rejects a structurally incomplete new plan before coordination mutation, binds continuation to the accepted plan revision, and never grants a planned claim bootstrap authority merely from path shape.

canonical_journey.starting_state: PI-02C is accepted, the exact v5 maintenance allocation remains active on its closed claim, and authentic PI-02E dogfood proved a qualified planned claim can be misclassified as bootstrap when all owned paths match the bootstrap allowlist.
canonical_journey.input: The exact active v5 allocation, one revision-bound PI-02F claim and selection-pending tracker, the accepted Plan 125 graph, and a v7 contract limited to the bootstrap-identity source, focused tests, and transition artifacts.
canonical_journey.action: Prove the pending claim cannot write source, park v5, allocate and select v7 on that exact claim through runtime plan binding, then require exact UNPLANNED identity before path-scoped bootstrap admission.
canonical_journey.observable_result: The explicit unplanned bootstrap remains admitted; the qualified planned safe-path claim routes to selected admission; claim, tracker, worktree, graph, allocation, and selection agree before the source repair is applied.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: A qualified plan receives bootstrap authority from path shape; the source patch lands before v7 selection; v5 remains active while v7 allocates; allocation or selection binds another claim; or mixed and foreign bootstrap paths are admitted.
